verdict.rationale: MX documents free, self-serve developer API keys from the Client Dashboard (mx-docs-32). It also offers four test institutions for sandbox connections (mx-docs-8) and an OpenAPI spec you can import into Postman to explore requests (mx-docs-12, mx-gh-1). Its only documented SDKs, React Native and Web, embed the Connect Widget UI (mx-docs-29, mx-docs-30); they are not server-side API client libraries across languages, and the evidence shows no runnable quickstart. Missing for 10: a documented runnable end-to-end quickstart, official server-side client libraries in multiple languages, and independent evidence of time-to-first-linked-account.
